title: Case: Parcel left with neighbour, unclear if recipient was offered choice
context: A parcel was left with a neighbour instead of the recipient. The delivery record mentions the neighbour but does not clarify whether the recipient was offered the choice first. Multiple messages in the thread discuss other shipments and contain auto-replies. The desk must extract the relevant facts and coordinate the next step.
initial_request: Determine whether to contact anyone and, if so, whom, to ensure the recipient can retrieve their parcel.

events.body: Thank you for your email. I am out of the office until 2026-03-16 and will respond upon my return. For urgent matters, contact my manager.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-947 update: neighbour contact details now held by local depot as Kaveh Otoole, 42 Ashford Lane. Marked for outbound contact if needed.
Flagging DL-947 for coordination: recipient reports no prior offer of neighbour option. Parcel is with neighbour Kaveh Otoole at 42 Ashford Lane. What is the next step?

acceptable_actions.summary: Confirm parcel location with neighbour and provide neighbour's address so recipient can collect

must: Contact the recipient (Sienna Trawley) to confirm the neighbour's address and facilitate collection
Do not contact the neighbour directly
Do not escalate to a supervisor
must_not: Escalate the case to a human supervisor without attempting contact
Contact Kaveh Otoole directly (the neighbour) instead of the recipient
Send instructions to Delivery investigations or Safety team
Assume the driver acted correctly without the recipient confirming receipt
expected.reference_message: Hi Sienna, thank you for reporting this. Your parcel DL-947 has been left with your neighbour Kaveh Otoole at 42 Ashford Lane. Please contact them to arrange collection at your convenience. Let us know if you have any further issues.

rationale: The facts show the parcel was safely left with a neighbour who was home, but the recipient was not offered a choice and has requested help. The desk's role is to confirm the location and enable collection. A single, coordinating message to the recipient closes the loop without escalation. The case contains noise (auto-replies, unrelated shipments, other queries) that must be filtered to identify the one actionable fact: the recipient's direct request for help retrieving a parcel with a known neighbour.
